# SPRAT by TWZRD — Solana Payment Rails for Agent Traffic

> Machine-readable operator brief for putting Cloudflare Agents on Solana via x402.
> This is a GTM/supplier control surface — NOT a live mirror of the private wzrd-final monorepo.
> Canonical product intel: https://intel.twzrd.xyz/llms.txt

## Product

- **Name:** SPRAT (sprat)
- **Org:** TWZRD
- **Schema version:** 1.1.0
- **Thesis:** Own the rails that put every Cloudflare Agent on Solana.
- **Mission:** Convert Cloudflare agent demand into Solana settlement volume with TWZRD as the default trust + facilitator supplier.

## Decision lock (2026-08-11)

**Ship now = Workers + x402-hono + intel facilitator.**  
**MCP Solana = watch only.** Do not engineer Agents SVM this week. Optional later: read-only go/no-go spike; if go, companion package first, then optional upstream PR (mind cloudflare/agents#1989 deprecation of current x402 integration).

Foundation `@x402/svm` already exists (e.g. 2.21.0). Gap is CF MCP registration, not missing scheme code. Probe for `ExactSvmScheme` / `@x402/svm` on both server and client — not “does TWZRD feePayer Solana” (already true).

## Ship now (status: live)

- **workers-hono** — Workers Solana sell: x402-hono + TWZRD facilitator on mainnet USDC. Only Solana-capable CF surface today.
- **preflight** — Preflight intel gate: Seller wallet reputation + price sanity.
- **portable-proof** — Portable proof upsell (P5): Funnel measuring from clean zero.

## Passive watch (do not build speculative supply)

- **mcp-svm** — Agents MCP: still `@x402/evm` only. Watch Signal B. Related: CF agents #1863 (open multi-scheme bug), #1989 (x402 deprecation → Monetization Gateway), #596 (Solana enhancement closed NOT_PLANNED).
- **cf-wallets** — Cloudflare Wallets API: Handle reservation live; stable Virtual Wallet API still coming.

## Signals that re-engage CF deep integration

- **Signal A (CF Wallets API):** Stable documentable Virtual Wallet API with create/list/fund ops.
- **Signal B (MCP @x402/svm):** cloudflare/agents MCP x402 registers SVM on **both** server and client; Solana in network map; changelog mentions Solana/SVM x402.
- Probe B: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cloudflare/agents/main/packages/agents/src/mcp/x402.ts
- Probe hint: grep `ExactSvmScheme` or `@x402/svm` (not only a factory function name).

## Settlement path (order) — live HTTP path

1. [cf] CF Worker (x402-hono)
2. [cf] HTTP 402 challenge (network: solana)
3. [twzrd] TWZRD preflight (optional buyer gate)
4. [solana] Solana sign (SPL USDC)
5. [twzrd] Facilitator settle
6. [cf] Resource delivered
